english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: Proof of English proficiency required (e.g., TOEFL/IELTS or waiver for equivalent home English coursework); no fixed exchange test cutoff published.
english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.notes: AUK visiting-student admissions page requires proof of English proficiency (or equivalent completed English coursework), without publishing a bilateral exchange score cutoff.

host_language_requirement.notes: No Arabic prerequisite stated for incoming exchange students; curriculum taught in English.

fall_term_dates.value: AY 2026-2027 Fall: New Student Orientation Sep 13, 2026; Classes Sep 15, 2026 – Jan 14, 2027 (Exams Jan 10–14, 2027; Winter Break Dec 24–31, 2026).
fall_term_dates.notes: Official AY 2026-2027 academic calendar (earlier 2024-2025 fact sheet page 4 listed Sep 22 – Jan 23).

spring_term_dates.value: AY 2026-2027 Spring: Classes Jan 31, 2027 – Jun 3, 2027 (Exams May 30 – Jun 3, 2027; lunar holidays tentative).
spring_term_dates.notes: Official AY 2026-2027 academic calendar (earlier 2024-2025 fact sheet page 4 listed Feb 16 – Jun 19).

housing_notes.value: Various off-campus accommodation options near campus in Salmiya; on-campus dormitories are not stated.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.notes: Fact sheet specifies Kuwait visitor e-Visa portal and 90-day expiry; exact lead time and bank-balance threshold are not stated.
